PriceTier.meaning: PriceTier prototype for the bounded base-price quote.

amountMinor.meaning: Exact nonnegative USD cents represented by UInt64.

minQuantity.meaning: Inclusive lower quantity bound; null becomes zero.

maxQuantity.meaning: Inclusive upper quantity bound; null becomes UInt64 maximum.

QuoteRequest.meaning: QuoteRequest prototype for the bounded base-price quote.

requestedQuantity.meaning: Explicit positive integer unit count, capped at 2147483647 by this prototype contract.

EligiblePrices.meaning: All currency-matching tiers containing the explicit quantity, sorted by exact unit amount ascending; ties remain visible.

LineSubtotal.meaning: Exact UInt64 multiplication of selected unit cents by requested quantity; overflow is an error, not rounding.
